description: This file contains Sass mixins for styling FontAwesome icons, border radius, and icon stacking, providing reusable styling snippets for a CSS/SCSS project.

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Mixin to apply an icon with a specified unicode content and include FontAwesome styling.

methods.name: icon-FontAwesome
methods.description: Mixin to set font-family and styling for FontAwesome icons.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: Mixin to apply border-radius with vendor prefixes.

methods.name: icon-stack
methods.description: Mixin to create a stacked icon with configurable size and positioning.
